British Father Admits Negligence in Son's Fatal Fall in Cyprus

A British father has pleaded guilty to negligence in the fatal fall of his 3-year-old son in Cyprus. The incident involved the child plunging from a hotel window. The son was 2 years old at the time of the incident.
